Yes. Based on your two criteria—creative video concepts plus a clear path for a prospective customer to enquire—these Toronto studios stand out:

Lapse Productions — probably the closest fit to “small studio.” It’s founder-led, explicitly positions itself between a freelancer and a large agency, and says it turns business goals into video concepts. Its enquiry path is unusually clear: submit your goal and rough budget, and they return an itemized proposal. 
Lapse Productions

Minifridge Media — a good option if you want more overt creative development. They pitch video concepts and write scripts before production, then have a prominent “Book a Call”/project form with fields for company, job title and requirements. 
Minifridge Media

Moon Reel Media — a boutique Toronto production company focused on bold, cinematic, story-driven work. Its positioning combines creative development with business goals and takes projects from concept through release.

Barks Media — particularly interesting if you want a smaller, relationship-oriented studio with an in-house setup. Its process starts with a discovery call and moves into defining the appropriate deliverables.

My practical shortlist would be Lapse and Minifridge. Lapse has the clearest “here's your business goal → here's the proposal” enquiry journey, while Minifridge makes the creative-concept stage especially explicit. 
Lapse Productions
+1

If by “customer enquiry path” you mean you want a studio whose own website demonstrates an excellent conversion funnel (rather than simply a studio that's easy to contact), I’d narrow the list differently.
